# NKSkills public pilot — reviewer summary (supplement to the helper report) Status: **partial**. This note supplements the validated helper artifacts; it does not replace them. Counts below are copied from `report-01/coverage.json` and the helper validation outputs in `logs/`. The customer report is `report-01/report.md` / `report-01/report.html` / `report-01/content-actions.csv`. ## Scope - Sole authorized origin: https://nkskills.getgroove.me. Static navigation reachable from `/`, maxPages=30, maxDepth=5. - Anonymous raw HTTP only, through the packaged helpers. No browser, no script execution, no credentials, no analytics. - Owner context used as attributed evidence: NKSkills composes versioned skill workflows for Codex and Claude Code; English and Vietnamese audiences. AIO here means AI search optimization; no Google AI Overviews measurements exist for this run. ## Discovery - `initial-discovery` validated before use (valid, 1 capture, stopped at maxPages=1 with 6 unvisited pages queued). It was not modified. - Continued with `discovery-resume` into `discovery-continued` (maxPages=30, maxDepth=5): 11 page captures, 12 inventory records, frontier empty, status partial. - No count or depth budget remains pending: 11 of 30 page captures were used and no unvisited-page or depth entry is left in the queue. No count/depth continuation is needed. - Remaining discovery queue (13 entries, carried into the campaign): 10 rendering-unreviewed HTML documents, 1 page-extraction entry for `/licenses/README.txt`, 1 source-incomplete, 1 scope-unconfirmed. - 24 distinct external github.com targets were recorded as origin exclusions and were not requested. - scopeComplete=false and inventoryComplete=false: CMS records, orphan pages and rendered navigation are not supplied. ## Coverage (validated) | Measure | Value | | --- | --- | | Declared items | 12 | | Collected | 12 | | Fully audited | 0 | | Pending | 12 | | Failed / blocked / unsupported / excluded | 0 / 0 / 0 / 0 | | Missing checks | 0 of 312 planned | | Pending queue | 13 | | completionAllowed | false | | Global rules unresolved | portfolio-task-gaps | All 12 snapshots were read in full, but no item is fully audited: every item still has unknown checks that need evidence this pilot does not have (see "Remaining evidence needs"). ## Findings (4 local, 0 global) ### F-002 — medium severity, medium confidence, observed The four host guides list prerequisite tools without saying what they are or where to get them. The prerequisites list contains this entry: "
  • codegraph, rtk
    • " (bc5f2053beb54d2a38604ef60c9568f9a228a17ada91de8a9c9c33cfe8b2b742.txt:1). The link to the external technical guide on that page is labelled "Read archive and digest verification →" (bc5f2053beb54d2a38604ef60c9568f9a228a17ada91de8a9c9c33cfe8b2b742.txt:5). Only the solution page labels the same external document "Read the full technical setup →" (be4e698fc093f3f0e37d843faabc6cd42ddb3203d3fb059d66214be5fa93f5bb.txt:1). None of the 12 collected items defines codegraph or rtk or explains index creation. Whether the external guide does is unverified (excluded origin). User impact is inferred, not measured. Affected: `/en/guides/codex/`, `/en/guides/claude-code/`, `/vi/guides/codex/`, `/vi/guides/claude-code/`. ### F-001 — low severity, high confidence, observed The Vietnamese catalog eyebrow label is truncated. Vietnamese catalog source: "

    NKSKILLS / DANH MỤ

    " (0c98394d57ea1913d48651f83b0478ad5681be504d20b99c46571b642aa577a2.txt:1). English counterpart: "

    NKSKILLS / CATALOG

    " (5a243609b1b0ecc5174aba7b4557ed478fde8ff58d8c4852ff6860a1d616dca5.txt:1). Proposed correction (not a quotation): NKSKILLS / DANH MỤC. ### F-003 — low severity, medium confidence, inferred The Vietnamese FAQ answer on commercial readiness can be read the opposite way. FAQ answer: "Chưa. Bản 0.1.0 là ứng viên đánh giá; cổng phát hành thương mại vẫn mở." (f4bd5e3fcb89c250167c6a5645bffad4ee9b92bce144ad2ef337d0587166bb67.txt:1). Solution card on the same page: "Chưa qua cổng phát hành thương mại." (f4bd5e3fcb89c250167c6a5645bffad4ee9b92bce144ad2ef337d0587166bb67.txt:1). The misreading risk is a reviewer inference and needs a native-speaker check. Affected: `/vi/`. ### F-004 — low severity, medium confidence, inferred Status statements carry versions but no date. Example: "A direct-download archive is not published yet." (d65a15d10c4b3d864ee5627f82ed0a1aa4ae6fd7f7a6882efeb09bbc4d66947e.txt:1). No calendar date appears in the source of any of the 10 HTML documents (string probe recorded in the inventory-map evidence). Whether any statement is stale is unknown. ## What checked out (narrow, raw-source judgments) - All 12 requests ended in HTTP 200; `/` answers 308 to `/en/`. - Canonical: each of the 10 HTML documents declares one self-canonical equal to its final URL and og:url. - Locales: five EN/VI pairs with reciprocal hreflang (en, vi, x-default → EN), matching `html lang`, both sides collected. - Internal links: every in-scope target returned 200 and every fragment link resolves to an id in the target source. - Cross-page and EN/VI consistency: versions, statuses, hosts, component count, prerequisites, invocation tokens, catalog counts and pinned upstream links agree. This is agreement among pages, not verification against release records. - Media: one decorative brand image with empty alt; the workflow diagram has a text description. ## Uncovered, unsupported and rendering-dependent items - Rendered DOM for all 10 HTML documents: unknown (seo-rendering unknown; discovery rendering-unreviewed queue retained). - `/licenses/README.txt`: collected as text/plain, but static-link extraction does not support it (page-extraction queue retained). It names three files as plain text, for example "Full notice: fraunces-OFL.txt" (1b6ad064b40b30886119c80c38a808ea8061d3de3b21a95831bda858bb483dcc.txt:4). Those three files are not hyperlinks, are not in the inventory and were not requested. - robots.txt declares a sitemap at /sitemap.xml. It is not reachable by static navigation and was not collected, so sitemap-only or orphan URLs are unknown. - github.com release record, manifests, catalog.yaml and technical guide: excluded origin, not collected. - Stylesheets, scripts, fonts and the og:image files: not collected. ## Remaining evidence needs - Claim sources (release record, manifests): needed for quality-claims, quality-freshness, aeo-answer-evidence. - Publisher intent for indexing, snippets and crawler classes: needed for seo-index-controls and aio-crawler-policy. - Real question set (search, support, sales): needed for the three AEO rules and portfolio-task-gaps. - Authoritative entity record with versions and status: needed for aio-entity-consistency. - Rendered DOM capture in an authorized browser: needed for seo-rendering and seo-structured-data. - AI response observations with prompts and cohorts: needed for the three GEO rules. - Rankings, indexing, crawler logs, citations and conversions were not supplied and remain unknown, not zero. ## Continuation - Count/depth: none required. - To close discovery: supply a CMS or repository export and authorize either sitemap traversal (`discover-sitemaps` seeded with /sitemap.xml) or a rendered-navigation capture; then build a new discovery union and campaign. - To resolve unknown checks: attach the evidence listed above through a new `campaign-review-parts` revision of `campaign-02-reviewed`, then re-index and submit a new global receipt.
